class.name: StudioBank
class.brief_description: A collection of sound samples and meta data
class.description: Banks made in FMOD Studio contain the metadata and audio sample data required for runtime mixing and playback. Audio sample data may be packed into the same bank as the event metadata which references it, or it may be packed into separate banks.

method.name: get_bus_count
method.description: Retrieves the number of buses in the bank. This is only relevant for master banks, as other banks do not contain buses.

method.name: get_bus_list
method.description: Retrieves a list of the buses in the bank. This is only relevant for master banks, as other banks do not contain buses.

method.name: get_event_count
method.description: Retrieves the number of event descriptions in the bank.

method.name: get_event_list
method.description: Retrieves a list of the event descriptions in the bank.

method.name: get_sample_loading_state
method.description: Retrieves the loading state of the samples in the bank.

method.name: get_string_count
method.description: Retrieves the number of string table entries in the bank. This is only relevant for studio string banks, as other banks do not contain string tables.

method.name: get_string_info
method.description: Retrieves a string table entry. This is only relevant for studio string banks, as other banks do not contain string tables.

method.name: get_vca_count
method.description: Retrieves the number of VCAs in the bank.

method.name: get_vca_list
method.description: Retrieves a list of the VCAs in the bank.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Checks that the bank reference is valid.

method.name: load_sample_data
method.description: Loads non-streaming sample data for all events in the bank.

method.name: unload_sample_data
method.description: Unloads non-streaming sample data for all events in the bank.
